messages:
zoe: Post-all-hands quick Qs for leadership thread. Keeping it short so we can publish a tidy FAQ.

zoe: 1) In one line, what's the strategic promise we want customers to remember?

mike: "Predictable inference: lower latency, lower unit cost, same API everywhere." Emphasize predictable.

zoe: 2) What's the clearest difference vs hyperscaler managed endpoints?

clara: Hyperscalers offer model hosting; we offer a production runtime + operational knobs (batching, caching, quant profiles) and rollout/rollback primitives. That difference matters for SLOs and costs.

ojas: Add: our Observable Console + token-level cost breakdown is a big differentiator for engineers.

zoe: 3) For top-of-funnel marketing, should we say "build vs buy" or "Redwood vs Cloud"?

mike: Prefer "build vs buy" as the narrative. For later-stage materials have a precise "vs Cloud" appendix with concrete numbers. Avoid vendor name-calling up front.

zoe: 4) What's one metric we can publish publicly without oversharing?

clara: Publish a reference p95 latency for a standard prompt size and a sample per-token cost range for a common config. Internals keep SLO attainment metrics private.

zoe: 5) Any objections to a short public FAQ from this thread?

mike: No objections. Keep it < 500 words, include one anonymized customer benchmark, and link to a technical appendix.

ops-bot: all-hands slides uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/all-hands/3250000000

zoe: Thanks everyone 44d closing thread and assigning follow-ups: @mike to write draft FAQ, @clara to supply benchmark blurb.
